Yes, the European car industry is doomed IF it tries to compete with China in the things in which china is good. And so is any other car industry that tries to do the same without the protection of tariffs. 

When it comes to manufacturing speed, quantity and cost effectiveness china is unbeatable. Nobody can pack more screens, more equipment, more cameras, more power, and more “luxury” into a car for less money.

The way we buy things has also changed in a way that favors Chinese cars. Brand loyalty and word of mouth marketing simply doesn’t matter as much anymore. Our decisions are now mostly devoid of emotion and intuition. Buying a chinese car is like going on amazon and buying something from one of those amazon brands with weird names.
